mepDesc: We stay updated with the latest methods and techniques in electro-mechanical contracting.
mepDetail: S&PA delivers complete MEP contracting packages covering mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems. Our teams coordinate design and site execution to keep projects efficient, compliant, and ready for reliable operation.
mepFeature2: Supply and installation with certified materials
facilityDesc: We provide the services needed to manage vital places where people work, live, and achieve their goals.
facilityDetail: Our facility management approach keeps critical workplaces and living environments running smoothly. From operations planning to on-site support, we help clients protect assets and maintain performance.
facilityFeature2: On-site technical support for critical facilities
ictDesc: Full-fledged ICT and telecom contracting — end-to-end digital infrastructure delivery.
ictDetail: We design and deliver digital infrastructure for resilient networks and mission-critical environments. Our ICT scope covers structured cabling, telecom systems, and reliable connectivity across facilities.
maintenanceDesc: Our purpose is to lead facility management by enhancing services, relationships, and profitability.
maintenanceDetail: Professional maintenance from S&PA protects installed systems after handover. We support preventive programs, rapid response, and long-term reliability for MEP and ICT assets.
maintenanceFeature3: Lifecycle care for MEP and ICT assets
